_meta.description: LLM-compiled structured officer abilities, derived from the free-text descriptions in profiles/player_profile.json. Each officer has a captain maneuver (cm) OR below-deck ability (bda), plus an officer ability (oa).
_meta.targets_note: hostile types, factions, or enemy ship classes the ability is conditional on; empty = unconditional
_meta.works_in_source: Ground truth from STFC Cheat Sheet M92 (quasel/JulesVern/Lightbull), RawOfficers tab, retrieved 2026-07-11. Lists contexts where the ability actually applies per exported game data; overrides the inferred scope.
_meta.values_note: values = per-rank ability magnitudes (rank 1-5) from M92 RawOfficers game export
